contribution.position: Reliability evidence is split and insufficient for a confident read this week. The test report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) and perf report (p99 within budget at peak) are encouraging, but the incident log shows a 30-day error rate of 1.5% against a 0.2% SLO with two sev2 incidents. It is unclear from the artifacts whether that error budget breach predates the change, is caused by it, or is independent of it. Before the reliability axis can be called either way, we need attribution of the sev2 incidents and error-rate trend relative to the change, plus confirmation that the runbook rollback path covers the observed failure modes.
